import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DATABASES={
        'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'},
        'other': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'},
    },
    DATABASE_ROUTERS=['router_mod.Router'],
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
import router_mod  # noqa
django.setup()

from django.db import connections
from django.db.migrations.recorder import MigrationRecorder

rec_other = MigrationRecorder(connections['other'])
try:
    rec_other.record_applied('myapp', '0001_initial')
    print('record_applied on other: no error')
except Exception as exc:
    print('record_applied on other raised:', type(exc).__name__, exc)

tables = connections['other'].introspection.table_names(connections['other'].cursor())
print('django_migrations on other?', 'django_migrations' in tables)

rec_def = MigrationRecorder(connections['default'])
rec_def.record_applied('myapp', '0001_initial')
tables_d = connections['default'].introspection.table_names(connections['default'].cursor())
print('django_migrations on default?', 'django_migrations' in tables_d)
EOF

import django
from django.conf import settings

class Router:
    def allow_migrate(self, db, app_label, model_name=None, **hints):
        return db == 'default'

settings.configure(
    DATABASES={
        'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'},
        'other': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'},
    },
    DATABASE_ROUTERS=[Router()],
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connections
from django.db.migrations.recorder import MigrationRecorder

rec_other = MigrationRecorder(connections['other'])
try:
    rec_other.record_applied('myapp', '0001_initial')
    print('record_applied on other: no error')
except Exception as exc:
    print('record_applied on other raised:', type(exc).__name__, exc)

tables = connections['other'].introspection.table_names(connections['other'].cursor())
print('django_migrations on other?', 'django_migrations' in tables)

rec_def = MigrationRecorder(connections['default'])
rec_def.record_applied('myapp', '0001_initial')
tables_d = connections['default'].introspection.table_names(connections['default'].cursor())
print('django_migrations on default?', 'django_migrations' in tables_d)
print('applied on default:', list(rec_def.applied_migrations()))
EOF
